label: Models and training
text: CS.O.A4.2 Models and training — neural networks; universal approximation holds for one-hidden-layer networks with a non-polynomial activation, approximating continuous functions on compact sets to any accuracy. It says nothing about learnability. Empirical scaling laws are W4 claims within stated ranges.

warrant.standard: held-out evaluation, stated metric and variance, replication
warrant.defeaters: data leakage, benchmark overfitting, distribution shift
